column1: # level id <TAB> solution as the table prints it <TAB> why the mismatch is a content (or content-vs-engine) bug, not a harness problem
column2: # Listed mismatches are printed as CONTENT-BUG by scripts/check/G-01.sh; the check still exits 1 until they are fixed. Delete a line when the bug is fixed.

column3: The level has no setup, so user:<id>:name and otp:<id> written by the reference run are still there when the wrong solution runs and its checks pass. Add setup: DEL user:{{player.id}}:name user:{{player.id}} otp:{{player.id}}.

The last check uses JSON.ARRLEN player:p-028 $.tags with matches: "2", but the $ path makes Redis reply with a list ([2]) and matches only accepts a string reply. Use equals: [2] (or an unwrapped path).

The event verifier waits for custom event progress_restored, but nothing emits it: POST /api/progress/restore (engine/src/server.ts) only emits progress.changed, and the UI does not post it. The spec (C1) says the engine emits it. Engine or UI change needed; the level is fine.
